# Route1 development fixture

47 real NCN Route1 features clipped to a Gravesend bounding box. Source and
fixture SHA-256, source edit time, projection origin and attribution are recorded
in source.json. Reference geometry is public data under OGL3.0; the source item
also lists OS attribution and NI OSM/ODbL attribution for the full UK dataset.
This clipped fixture is confined to England.

Observations generated by scripts/ncn_trial are synthetic. TEST-prefixed route
labels, parallel alternatives and observation accuracy are controlled fixtures,
not claims about actual routes, people, GPS conditions or surviving mileposts.
The trial is not imported by the backend or Android app.
